description: Mark items as favorites (favorite=true, default) or remove the favorite (favorite=false).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

media_keys.description: Library media keys (AF1Qip...) from list_media / search_media, as a JSON array or comma-separated.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: set_favorite
